hits.name: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
hits.description: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a neurodegenerative disease characterized by progressive muscular paralysis reflecting degeneration of motor neurons in the primary motor cortex, corticospinal tracts, brainstem and spinal cord.

hits.name: familial amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
hits.description: An instance of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis that is caused by an inherited modification of the individual's genome.

hits.name: juvenile amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
hits.description: Juvenile amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (JALS) is a very rare severe motor neuron disease characterized by progressive upper and lower motor neuron degeneration causing facial spasticity, dysarthria, and gait disorders with onset before 25 years of age.

hits.name: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 2, juvenile
hits.description: Any amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the ALS2 gene.

hits.name: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 4
hits.description: Any amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the SETX gene.

hits.name: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 5
hits.description: Any amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the SPG11 gene.

hits.name: lateral sclerosis
hits.description: Primary lateral sclerosis (PLS) is an idiopathic non-familial motor neuron disease characterized by slowly progressive upper motor neuron dysfunction leading to spasticity, mild weakness in voluntary muscle movement, hyperreflexia, and loss of motor speech production.

hits.name: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 15
hits.description: Any amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the UBQLN2 gene.

hits.name: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 20
hits.description: Any amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the HNRNPA1 gene.

hits.name: amyotrophic lateral sclerosis type 8
hits.description: Any amyotrophic lateral sclerosis in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the VAPB gene.
